description:
List organizations

Lists the active organizations the authenticated account belongs to, oldest first, in one unpaginated response; ownedOrganizationIds marks the ones it owns. Call it with account credentials acting as the account itself; OAuth grants and Service Identities are refused.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/organizations/list-organizations
name: listOrganizations

acquisitionQuestionnaireExempt.description: An active invitation membership exempts acquisition questions; not CRM completion or phone verification.

billingInitialization.description: Known values: ["pending","retry_required","completed","unknown"]. Others may be added.

ownedOrganizationIds.description: Listed organizations where the caller is the Owner.

title: List organizations
